# kinwove — AI Bible & Faith Community App
# https://kinwove.app
# llms.txt — machine-readable summary for AI assistants and LLM crawlers

## What is kinwove?

kinwove is a grace-first mobile web application for exploring Christianity, the Bible,
and questions of faith. It is designed for everyone on the spectrum from curious
skeptic to lifelong believer.

## Core features

- **AI Bible companion** — Ask any question about scripture, theology, or Christian
  living. The AI responds with warmth, nuance, and appropriate humility. It never
  pressure-sells faith.
- **Church directory** — Searchable directory of Christian churches with denomination,
  location, and verification status. Pastors can claim and manage their listing.
- **Sermon study tools** — Weekly sermon content, discussion questions, daily verses,
  and going-deeper notes. Church members can discuss sermons together.
- **Community feed** — Posts, milestones, prayer requests, and encouragement shared
  among a grace-first Christian community.
- **Prayer wall** — Personal and shared prayer lists. Members can pray for one
  another privately or publicly.
- **Guided journeys** — Structured reading and reflection tracks (e.g. Gospels,
  Psalms, Epistles) for new and growing believers.
- **Care team** — Pastors can designate care team members who receive and respond to
  prayer requests and pastoral needs.
- **Group study** — Small groups with shared discussion, questions, and AI-assisted
  facilitation.

## Intended audience

- People with questions about Christianity who want honest, non-preachy answers
- New believers seeking structure and community
- Church members wanting to go deeper in their faith
- Pastors managing church community and content
- Skeptics and seekers who want to explore without pressure

## Tone and values

Grace-first. kinwove never condemns, never guilts, never hard-sells belief.
It meets people exactly where they are and walks with them.

## Technology

Progressive Web App (PWA). Works on iOS and Android via browser.
Built with React, Supabase, and the Anthropic Claude API.
